title: S&P DJI December quarterly rebalance takes effect at the open — S&P 500/100/400/600 membership, share and float changes implemented at the 2027-12-17 close
source: EST: the index owner's own effective-date wording, RE-FETCHED THIS SESSION FROM THREE SEPARATE QUARTERS INCLUDING A DECEMBER ONE, then applied forward — the proposal rested on one September instance inherited from a sibling ledger; this initial research replaced that with three of its own. All three fetched direct from S&P DJI's own newsroom 2026-09-08, HTTP 200: (1) THE DECEMBER INSTANCE, press.spglobal.com/2025-12-05-CRH,-Carvana-and-Comfort-Systems-USA-Set-to-Join-S-P-500-... (79,722 bytes) — 'S&P Dow Jones Indices ("S&P DJI") will make the following changes to the S&P 500, S&P MidCap 400, and S&P SmallCap 600 indices effective prior to the open of trading on Monday, December 22, to coincide with the quarterly rebalance', where the third Friday of December 2025 was 2025-12-19; (2) press.spglobal.com/2026-06-05-Marvell-Technology-and-Flex-Set-to-Join-S-P-500-... (80,393 bytes) — 'Monday, June 22, 2026', third Friday 2026-06-19; (3) press.spglobal.com/2026-09-04-Bloom-Energy,-Illumina,-and-Everpure-... (79,423 bytes) — 'Monday, September 21, 2026', third Friday 2026-09-18. Same sentence, three quarters, one geometry: effective prior to the open of the Monday following that quarter's third Friday, implemented at that Friday's close. A FOURTH, SEC-FILED PRIMARY NAMES DECEMBER EXPLICITLY and was re-fetched this session rather than inherited: SEC EDGAR, Select Sector SPDR Trust Form 497 (accession 0001193125-26-031948, d85739d497.htm, HTTP 200, 2,388,335 bytes) — 'Changes will become effective after the market close on the third Friday of March, June, September and December.' Applied to December 2027: the third Friday is 2027-12-17 (weekday arithmetic recomputed mechanically this session — the December 2027 Fridays are the 3rd, 10th, 17th, 24th and 31st — and independently confirmed on OCC's own 2027 calendar by opex-2027-12-17), so the rebalance is effective prior to the open on MONDAY 2027-12-20 and implemented at the 2027-12-17 close. THE METHODOLOGY PRIMARY WAS ATTEMPTED AGAIN AND IS STILL BLOCKED: spglobal.com/spdji/en/documents/methodologies/methodology-sp-us-indices.pdf returned HTTP 403 to this runner on 2026-09-08 (recorded in this event's ledger probe-ref.blocked), so no rebalancing-schedule clause was read from the methodology itself and nothing was silently substituted. Stays estimate on two counts, both narrower than the proposal's three: the confirmed-prefix taxonomy in market-events-data.ts has no member for an index owner's own published schedule (the same gap sp-quarterly-rebalance-effective-2026-09-21 and every Russell entry record), and no 2027-dated S&P DJI release exists yet — the December 2027 release is due around 2027-12-03. THE DATE IS NOT IN DOUBT; the estimate label is about the taxonomy and the missing instance, not the evidence. Checked 2026-09-08
notes: CANONICAL FILE WRITTEN BY THIS EVENT'S OWN INITIAL RESEARCH (2026-09-08), which read the single proposal carrying this id (proposals/sp-quarterly-rebalance-effective-2027-12-20.from-opex-2027-12-17.json) in full first and then re-sourced the effective-date rule itself. Ledger: docs/research/events/sp-quarterly-rebalance-effective-2027-12-20.md. THE PROPOSER'S FLAGGED UNKNOWN IS DISCHARGED, AND THE ANSWER IS A NULL. proposals/opex-2027-12-17.from-consumer-confidence-2027-12-22.json warned that 'December triple witching is the one expiration that also carries annual index reconstitution flow in some index families; this lane did not research that and makes no claim about it.' The family is Nasdaq's, and its schedule is now sourced verbatim from Nasdaq's own index methodology PDF (indexes.nasdaqomx.com/docs/methodology_NDX.pdf, fetched direct 2026-09-08, HTTP 200, 422,314 bytes): 'Reconstitution Frequency: Annually ... Reconstitution Effective Dates: At market open on the first trading day following the third Friday in December.' For 2027 that is 2027-12-20 — THE SAME SESSION AS THIS EVENT. It leaves no index-level footprint. On 21 December legs 2005-2026, QQQ's third-Friday relative volume shows no December step against its own other quarters (1.264x mean / 1.233x median vs 1.303x / 1.227x, Mann-Whitney p=88.9%); QQQ's relative volume on the effective open is the LOWEST of any bucket measured (0.864x / 0.898x, 6 of 21 above 1.0x); and QQQ's excess return over SPY on that session is 7 of 21 negative, sign p=18.9%, indistinguishable from other quarters (MW p=32.6%). THE INDEX-LEVEL NULL EXTENDS TO THE S&P LEG, DECEMBER-SPECIFICALLY. SPY total return on the December effective open runs 9 of 21 negative (sign p=66.4%), MW p=79.8% vs Mar/Jun/Sep and p=81.2% vs non-quarterly months; its relative volume is indistinguishable from ordinary December sessions (p=48.1%) and from the same Dec 18-24 calendar window (p=74.3%). TWO CANDIDATE FINDINGS WERE RAISED AND KILLED BY THEIR OWN CONTROLS, recorded so a later lane does not re-run them: a positive overnight gap on the December effective open (16 of 21, sign p=2.7%) dies against every other December session (251 of 421 positive, MW p=13.7%) and against other December Mondays (p=30.7%) — it is a December seasonal; and a large QQQ-minus-SPY third-Friday volume deficit (18 of 21, sign p=0.1%) dies against placebo first and second Fridays of December, which fire at 16 of 21 each (p=2.7%) — it measures December, not the reconstitution. What survives is the clean negative: no rebalance or reconstitution footprint on this session, on any channel measured. Symbols deliberately EMPTY, following the September 2026 sibling: what moves at a rebalance is individual constituents, and the December 2027 roster will not exist until S&P DJI publishes around 2027-12-03. TWO DATED ADJACENTS PROPOSED, both landing 2027-12-10 and neither tracked for this quarter: sp-rebalance-reference-close-2027-12-10 (the SEC-filed Select Sector reference close, the December sibling of the calendar's own sp-rebalance-reference-close-2027-03-12) and ndx-annual-reconstitution-announcement-2027-12-10 (methodology-dated, and the sibling ledger measured the ANNOUNCEMENT rather than the effective date as the session where anything happens). TWO DELIBERATELY DECLINED: ndx-annual-reconstitution-effective-2027-12-20, because it is a measured index-level null on the same session this entry already occupies, and sp-select-sector-secondary-reweight-2027-12-31, because the 2027-09-30 sibling is missing too and filing only December would be arbitrary — a later lane should file the pair or neither. Kind 'sector' matches the sibling market-structure flow entries; the enum has no index-flow member and the imperfect fit is named, not fixed from this lane. Filed estimate; nothing here licenses an entry.
